trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals align (RSI 60.8 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge), the strongest confirmed setup available despite a flat-to-slightly-negative tape.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.5%), not a clear risk-on signal. Rather than force capital into multiple names, we added one fully-confirmed position (AAPL) with all four technical signals aligned, and held the rest of the existing portfolio unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, consistent with a quiet consolidation session rather than a broad risk-off move. Trading volumes and sector breadth suggest investors were digesting recent gains rather than reacting to new negative news. In the absence of a strong directional signal, selective stock-picking based on technical confirmation was favored over broad market exposure.
market_education.summary_zh: 大型指數今日小幅走弱，並無單一明顯觸發因素，較像是一個平靜的整理交易日，而非廣泛的risk-off走勢。成交量與市場廣度顯示投資者正消化近期升幅，而非對新的負面消息作出反應。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下，我們選擇根據技術面確認進行精選個股操作，而非擴大整體市場曝險。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to line up together before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前等待多個技術訊號同時出現，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於均線，以及成交量放大，而不是只依賴單一訊號行動。這樣可以減少追高或誤判短暫波動的風險。
